entry.author: Climate Change Commission
entry.summary:
This webinar provides an overview of the Commission’s recent advice on whether international shipping and aviation emissions should be included in Aotearoa New Zealand's 2050 target. This advice formed part of our broader Review of the 2050 target: https://www.climatecommission.govt.nz/our-work/advice-to-government-topic/review-of-the-2050-emissions-target/2024-review-of-the-2050-emissions-target/final-report/
In this report, we've advised the Government that Aotearoa New Zealand can, and should, do more to reduce these emissions, and that they should be included in the 2050 target. 

The slides used in this webinar are available for download on the Commission's website: https://www.climatecommission.govt.nz/webinars

CHAPTERS:

Overview
00:00 About our role
03:07 Two reports on three interconnected pieces of advice
05:03 The 2050 emissions reduction target - current target and our recommendations

Our advice
06:39 International shipping and aviation emissions
08:50 Whether to include these emissions
10:01 'How recommendations'
12:48 How to count these emissions - context
14:03 What we heard during consultation
17:21 How we responded to what we heard

18:23 Q&A
